test: Image-native Man-grid literal bilateral fold — raw IPA, 20 shards

model.name: Image-native Lokapurusha / Man-grid bilateral fold

observed_structure: upper stepped/dense lattice split into left and right halves
lower stepped/dense lattice split into left and right halves
bilateral reflection about the central vertical axis

reconstruction_rule.word_projection: Lay a phonetic sequence laterally on one side. A literal vertical fold maps positions to the opposite side. Read in the same left-to-right convention after folding, so the spatial sequence is reversed.
reconstruction_rule.ipa_operation: reverse the raw IPA token sequence only
reconstruction_rule.orthographic_operation: reverse the normalized written sequence only

explicit_exclusions: No place, manner, voicing or stop/fricative substitutions
No old reconstructed-language forms are used as evidence
model.research_boundary: The manuscript image itself does not provide phonetic labels for individual cells. Therefore the only phonetic transform admitted here is the bilateral geometric fold that is visibly present. Any cell-to-phoneme assignment would be invented and is deliberately excluded.

design.primary_transform: Only the visible bilateral fold is used: raw IPA token order is mirrored/reversed.
design.prohibited: No 4x4, no 16-state bridge, no 16x16 gates, no row/column/transpose operators, no place/manner/voice transforms, no reconstructed-root forms.
design.matching: Exact normalized English meanings from one raw Wiktextract pass.
design.control: For each same-meaning pair, folded source is also compared with deterministic wrong meanings in the target language.
design.score: Normalized Levenshtein similarity on raw normalized IPA symbols; orthographic reversal is secondary only.
design.success: Folded same-meaning IPA must beat direct and wrong-meaning folded IPA, win more concepts than it loses, and have approximate paired 95% interval for fold-minus-direct entirely above zero.

boundary: This tests the literal bilateral fold visible in the supplied Man-grid image. It does not assume or import phonetic values for unlabeled manuscript cells.
